newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-SCHOLTEN TO LEAVE AJAX FOR JAPAN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SCHOLTEN TO LEAVE AJAX FOR JAPAN.

text.p: Ajax midfielder Arnold Scholten has signed an 18-month contract with Japanese J-league side JEF United, Dutch news agency ANP said on Tuesday.
Scholten, 34, who joined Ajax in 1995, was at the end of his contract with the Dutch club but they had offered to extend it.
He is the third leading player to leave Ajax following striker Patrick Kluivert and defender Winston Bogarde, who signed for AC Milan earlier in the year.
Coach Louis van Gaal will also move, possibly to Barcelona, though he has yet to confirm his destination.
